0022600021.text: The 5-0 Houston Rockets, who lead the Southwest and the West, visit the 3-2 Dallas Mavericks, who sit 2 games back in the Southwest and 7th in the West, in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game that is Houston's sixth of the season. Houston is missing Alperen Sengun (back soreness), Marcus Smart (forearm strain), and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Houston leads the 2026-27 series 1-0 after its 128-110 win in Houston on October 21.
